recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It repairs a concrete conformance-source defect in the already-approved Device.distributor element without broadening the published FHIR-25036 resolution or conflicting with the later DeviceDefinition packaging decision.
issue_request: FHIR-25036 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Device. It asked whether Device.manufacturer was really the manufacturer versus a labeler or other legally responsible party; the final resolution left Device.manufacturer as-is and added Device.distributor with name and organizationReference children.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to commit 949e41e; the underlying source commit c1f487b940 added Device.distributor to source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml. The element and children were present, but the parent element path value was incorrectly set to the human description text, so the conformance source did not correctly identify Device.distributor.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini, and Device.manufacturer already says it may identify the manufacturer or entity legally responsible for the device. Related DeviceDefinition distributor work was handled separately: FHIR-29727 was withdrawn/duplicate, and FHIR-30503 added DeviceDefinition.packaging.distributor while explicitly avoiding top-level DeviceDefinition.distributor.
reconciliation: Changed source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml so Device.distributor has path value Device.distributor and preserved the former path text as the element short description. No DeviceDefinition changes were made.
source_changes: source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml: corrected Device.distributor path to Device.distributor and added the existing descriptive text as short.

related_jiras.note: Requested DeviceDefinition.distributor but was withdrawn/duplicate in favor of FHIR-30503, so it was not separately decided here.
Added DeviceDefinition.packaging.distributor and instructed not to apply a top-level DeviceDefinition.distributor; it bounds this reconciliation to Device.distributor.
